tips.text: Wait for Mag's Duviri Circuit week instead of grinding if Systems will not drop.
Farm base Mag even if you own Mag Prime; they are separate Mastery items and Helminth subsume needs the base.
Keep hitting where the Sergeant was while he is cloaked; Flash Bang does not make him invulnerable.
Strip his shields with Magnetic or Toxin, then finish with anything.
Use a fast frame such as Volt, Gauss or Titania to fit more kills per hour; Nekros adds nothing since parts are mission rewards.
Join public matches freely; the part is a mission reward even if a veteran kills him first.
Players call the Sergeant a pushover; expect a handful of short runs, not a long grind.
